name: Nexthlon TrailFlex 2 Trail Running Shoes
description: The flagship trail-running weapon field-tested on the grueling 17 KM Hill Run. Built with 5mm Vibram Megagrip lugs, carbon-flex rock plate, and HydroShield waterproof protection. Delivers unmatched traction, downhill braking control, and foot fatigue protection across mountain altitudes.
highlights: Vibram® Megagrip Outsole: 5mm claw lugs lock into slick mud, gravel, and wet granite

Carbon-Flex Rock Shield: Guards underfoot against jagged stones and sharp trail debris
AeroFoam Pro Cushioning: 32mm/26mm stack height delivers cloud-soft impact absorption
Gaiter-Ready Collar: Prevents scree, pine needles, and dust from entering the shoe

specs.Terrain Support: Rocky Alpine Ridges, Mud, Steep Descents
